topic: Should we rewrite our frontend in Svelte?

entries.content: Frameworks come and go. Focus on shipping features.
Svelte has beautiful reactivity primitives. The syntax is clean.
The team knows React. Retraining costs time.
Developer happiness matters long-term. Technical debt compounds.
Hiring pool for React is larger.
Bundle sizes are typically smaller with Svelte, which helps perceived performance.
Adopt Svelte for new greenfield projects. Developer experience is the priority.
